notes.title: FIRST BETA IS FINALLY HERE!
notes.notes:
You should keep in mind this game has been developed by a single person as a hobby, so there are a lot of things that may seem simple. But as long as you play, you will understand where the magic is, and the amazing possibilities of what can become.

All kind of feedback will be very apreciated (suggestions, bugs, errors, new ideas, etc...)

Send an email to craftingtycoon@gmail.com.

Thanks to all!

notes.title: Crafting Tycoon right now!
notes.notes:
Good day!

I can finally present you Crafting Tycoon!
This is my very first game ever, no companies, no producers... only hard work :D

The game is still in the oven. There will be an available build for download as soon as possible, but it will be beta version with the main and basic systems working such as Transports AI or market values.

There are a lot of things to do, all feedback will be very appreciated, recomendations, bugs, possible future features, etc.

For now we can say the first version will be:

[h1]Crafting Tycoon v0.8 [/h1]

[u]Features :[/u]
All 5 country Levels
Offer/Demand prices for sell/buy
Demanding process
Vehicles AI
Market to Market Trading
Tutorial
The World Map!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31268235/c5d88d4477de2c4cdabfe5fbac80204a1c96dd47.jpg[/img]

[u]Future Features :[/u]
Road Events
Market values Events
Unique Vehicles characteristics


For all feedback please contact craftingtycoon@gmail.com

Thanks :D
